allelic loss on chromosome 16 is frequent in primary breast cancer, and that allelic loss at 16q24.2-24 is an independent marker for good prognosis in breast cancer.
allelic loss of chromosome 16q23-24 is a good prognostic marker in primary breast cancer.
allelic loss of the microsatellite marker 16q23-24.2 was found in 61% of primary breast cancers and was an independent marker of a good prognosis.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

allelic loss of the microsatellite marker, D16S511 at 16q, is a good prognostic marker in breast cancer, but the biological significance of the marker and the underlying gene(s) are unknown at this stage.

allelic loss of the 16q23-24 region is an independent prognostic marker of good prognosis, and is associated with the clinical parameters tumor size, lymph-node status, lymph-node capsule invasion, histopathology (grade), and estrogen receptor (ER) and progesterone receptor (PR) status.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
allelic loss at 16q24.2-24 is an independent marker for a better prognosis in primary breast cancers.

LOH at 3q13.3, 16q23-24 and 17p13 are independent prognostic markers for breast cancer.

allelic loss of the microsatellite marker, D16S511 at 16q24.2-23.2 is a good independent prognostic marker in primary breast cancer.
allelic loss of chromosome 16q23-24 is an independent prognostic marker for primary breast cancer patients.
